TITLE / FORMAT
Mimi Sticky / 15s Video

VISUAL STYLE
Bright and colorful animation with a playful tone.

CHARACTER / CONTINUITY
Mimi, an anthropomorphic bunny, interacts with sticky notes in a humorous and chaotic manner.

TIMED SHOT PLAN
0-2s: Mimi reaches toward the toy cabinet with a sticky note; instead of sticking to the cabinet, the note visibly clings to her finger [close-up on Mimi's hand] Mimi is in front of a toy cabinet, looking determined -> the note sticks to Mimi, not the cabinet
2-5s: Mimi tries to peel the stuck note away with her other hand; the note splits into two  Mimi pulls at the note -> one note sticks to each hand [tracking medium shot; focus Mimi tries to peel the stuck note away with her other hand; the note splits into two then one note sticks to each hand in a single continuous shot]
5-10s: Mimi continues to pull; each pull doubles the number of sticky notes  notes multiply from two to four to eight as she pulls, progressively covering her arms, legs and face -> Mimi is overwhelmed by notes [static wide shot; hold two; hold four; hold eight; single continuous shot]
10-12s: Mimi sees herself in a mirror and screams [close-up on Mimi's shocked face] Mimi is startled by her reflection completely covered in notes -> Mimi is startled
12-15s: Mimi sneezes and the sticky notes fly off [medium shot of notes flying] notes scatter and stick to the cabinet -> Mimi breathes a sigh of relief but the cabinet remains messy

AUDIO
Playful background music with sound effects for sneezing and notes sticking.

NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS
No dark themes or violence.

FINAL CUT
Mimi is relieved but the cabinet remains visibly messy.

CHARACTER IDENTITY LOCK
Mimi is the established anthropomorphic bunny character. Preserve that identity; do not render a human or invent unverified visual details. No approved visual reference is currently bound, so appearance details remain unverified.

PRODUCTION SETTINGS
Aspect ratio: 9:16. Target generator: SEEDANCE_2_0_MINI. Content profile: ABSURD_PHYSICS.

packets.approvedStory: Mimi, oyuncak dolabına 'Topla!' yazan bir yapışkan not yapıştırmak ister. Not, Mimi'nin parmağına yapışır. Mimi diğer eliyle çıkarmaya çalışırken not ikiye ayrılır ve iki eline de yapışır. Her çekişte notlar ikiye katlanarak çoğalır. Kısa sürede Mimi'nin kolları, bacakları ve yüzü notlarla kaplanır. Mimi aynada kendini görünce çığlık atar. Notlar o kadar çoğalır ki Mimi boğulacak gibi olur. Sonunda hapşırır ve tüm notlar uçuşarak dolabın üzerine yapışır. Mimi rahat bir nefes alır ama dolap hâlâ dağınıktır.
